SAMSON will be ported to Xbox Series X|S and PS5 after the PC launch.

“The game is running on consoles, but we don't have the bandwidth right now to start the final development. We have to go through the platform holder submissions and all that. Once the game is out on April 8, we'll get cracking on the console versions,” says Christofer Sundberg, founder of Liquid Swords.
